summary: Innovation Beverage Group filed a 6-K disclosing that on September 15, 2026, its board, on Audit Committee recommendation and after consulting current auditor M K CPAS and predecessor Astra Audit Advisory, concluded the FY2024 audited financial statements in its May 15, 2025 Form 20-F can no longer be relied upon and require restatement. Five correction areas include IP timing ($35,496 intangible increase, $115,418 prior-period amortization), impairment ($1,861,833 versus $612,072), $1,225,427 unrecorded equity commitments, debt equity components, and reclassifications. Material weaknesses cited; restated comparatives expected in the unfiled FY2025 Form 20-F. Cash position unaffected.
